name: Mike Lawler
summary: Michael Vincent Lawler (born September 9, 1986) is an American politician who serves as the U.S. representative for New York's 17th congressional district since 2023. The district includes all of Rockland County and Putnam County, as well as most of Northern Westchester County, and portions of southern Dutchess County. Previously, he was a member of the New York State Assembly representing the 97th district from 2021 to 2022.
